title: Micro Commit Agent For Cursor
description: Create .cursor/agents/micro-commit.md and .agents/skills/micro-commit/SKILL.md for fast WIP micro-commits: bump counter, parent wip header, timestamp, git diff summaries. Triggers: g, go, c, commit, +1.
summary: Fixed non-editable GitKraken commit message: stopped setting git commit.template (GK read-only mode). prepare-commit-msg now only refreshes when message still matches last prepare digest; user edits preserved. post-commit removes template files instead of truncating. Integration test script in ticket folder.
